claims: Initiate or continue broad-spectrum antimicrobial therapy for suspected infection given leukocytosis (WBC 116.1 K/uL), lactic acidosis, and hypotension.
Obtain blood cultures and additional infectious workup to identify source of marked leukocytosis and lactic acidosis.
Continue norepinephrine infusion for hemodynamic support and titrate to mean arterial pressure goal.
Replete calcium given ionized calcium 1.03 mmol/L and total calcium 7.2 mg/dL.
Monitor glucose closely and treat hyperglycemia (glucose 258 mg/dL, fingersticks 175-238) with insulin as needed.
Reassess acid-base status and lactate with repeat venous blood gas and lactate measurement.
Continue supplemental oxygen and monitor SpO2, which is 93-94% on room air with mild dyspnea.
Perform chest imaging to evaluate for pulmonary source of infection and hypoxemia.
